name: alisio
description: El aire acondicionado de Home Assistant, desde el escritorio de Linux

scripts.flatpak: node build.mjs && mkdir -p _build && flatpak-builder --user --install --force-clean _build/flatpak io.github.juhume.Alisio.json > _build/flatpak.log 2>&1 || (tail -30 _build/flatpak.log; exit 1)
scripts.test:ui: npm run flatpak && node build.mjs --tests && flatpak run --env=GSETTINGS_BACKEND=memory --env=ALISIO_SHOTS=${ALISIO_SHOTS:-} --filesystem=$PWD/build/tests:ro ${ALISIO_SHOTS:+--filesystem=$ALISIO_SHOTS} --command=gjs io.github.juhume.Alisio -m $PWD/build/tests/window.uitest.js
